biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of lightning and bolts. This dragon highly magical resistant and can absorb most spells.

Defense

AC 37, touch 15, flat-footed 30 (+22 natural, +7 dex, -2 size)

hp 551 [760] (19d12+152)

mp 141

Fort +21, Ref +18, Will +20

Absorb Lightning; DR 10/magic;

Immune Ability Drain, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Fear, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Sap, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie;

SR 27;

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 60 ft.

Melee Bite +31 (2d8+21 plus 2d6 lightning damage), 2 claws +31 (2d6+14 plus 1d6 lightning damage), tail slap +29 (2d6+21 plus 1d6 lightning damage)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (100-ft. line, 14d10 lightning damage, Reflex DC 27 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Small creatures, DC 27, 2d8+21), Gigavolt

Burst Mode Runic Guard

Spells Known (FC CL 19th, concentration +26)

0th (DC 17) - Bleed, Detect Magic, Mending, Message, Read Magic

1st (DC 18) - Shocking Grasp, Spark, Thunder

2nd (DC 19) - Defensive Shock, Elemental Resistance, See Invisibility, Spark II, Thunder II

3rd (DC 20) - Call Lightning, Dispel, Haste, Lightning Bolt, Spark III, Thundara, Thunder III

4th (DC 21) - Ball Lightning, Shock Spikes, Thunder IV, Vanish

5th (DC 22) - Call Lightning Storm, Lightning Arc, Shock, Thundaga

6th (DC 23) - Burst, Chain Lightning, Greater Dispel, Shock Spikes III

7th (DC 24) - Reflect, Shock II

8th (DC 25) - Burst II, Shock Spikes III, Stormbolts

9th (DC 26) - Lightning Form, Reflectga

Statistics

Str 38, Dex 24, Con 26, Int 24, Wis 24, Cha 22

Base Atk +19; CMB +35; CMD 52 (56 vs. trip)

Feats All-Consuming Swing, Cleave, Devastating Strike, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike

Skills Appraise +29, Bluff +28, Climb +37, Diplomacy +25, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (arcana) +29, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +29, Knowledge (technology) +29, Perception +29, Sense Motive +29, Spellcraft +29, Stealth +21, Survival +29

Languages Auran, Common, Draconic plus 3 more

SQ Beatdown, Magic Resistance

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Gold Dragon can charges up and shoots out a charged bolt towards its target or a 60-ft. radius of lightning centered shock wave from its self. The single target shot does 15d10 points of lightning damage or the radius blast does 10d10 points of lightning damage per target, a Reflex save for half damage (DC 26). description.value: [phase i] All magical spells and effects only deal 1/2 of their total damage except for water and lightning magical damage to Gold Dragon. This however does not interfere with Runic Guard.

description.value: [Begins Phase II] Once below 50% health (380), This Burst Mode lets Gold Dragon guard against most magic spells, making it impossible to hurt him with magic. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Gold Dragon gains a permanent Semi-Runic effect absorbing all spells with a 50% chance within 240-ft.-range of him and increases his Spell resistance to 30. This however doesn't effect SU abilities and summoner spells. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.
